title: com.hyprune.blueprint 0.1 world manifest value
description: Per-level blueprint SVGs in the frame of the package's com.hyprune.map 0.1 (RFC-0004 amendment). Levels are sorted by minY and must not overlap (maxY[i] <= minY[i+1]); each SVG is at most 65536 bytes, all levels together at most 262144 bytes, using the map SVG subset plus a class attribute from: grid floor wall stair opening screen mount area label route waypoint void outline. Consumers enforce those rules.
